version.changelog:
- Primera versión del módulo radar-tendencias-f100k para Autopilot F100K.
- Detecta tendencias emergentes antes de su punto máximo, ofreciendo una ventana de 24-72h para publicar primero.
- Opera junto al radar diario de lunes a viernes y solo notifica si hay tendencia real (sin spam).
- Funciona sobre OpenClaw (servidor + Telegram); las alertas se envían por Telegram en vez de correo.
- Identifica señales en TikTok, noticias y términos léxicos nuevos, clasificando entre CALIENTE, DESPEGANDO u OBSERVAR.
- Incluye generación automática de guion express de 30-45 segundos para aprovechar la tendencia detectada.

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed trend-monitoring workflow that searches public trend sources and alerts the user, with some cleanup needed around notification-channel wording.

dimensions.detail: The OpenClaw-specific header says alerts go through Telegram, while the legacy body still describes a Gmail draft workflow; this inconsistency should be corrected, but both channels are disclosed notification mechanisms for the same trend-alert purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled scripts, dependencies, executable payloads, or install-time behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation phrases are broad and the skill can also run on a schedule, so users should expect external trend searches when those phrases or automation invoke it.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill may create a missing local configuration from existing user/context files and may create an alert artifact, but it does not install persistence, modify system hooks, or request privilege escalation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to detect emerging content trends, using configured niche keywords, TikTok/Apify when available, web search, and an alert; those capabilities fit the trend-radar purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an automated trend radar that can read your F100K config, use web/TikTok search providers, and notify you through the configured channel. Before using it on a schedule, clarify whether OpenClaw should use Telegram only or allow Gmail drafts, and resolve the missing-config behavior.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases are real, but they invoke the disclosed trend-radar workflow rather than hidden or unrelated behavior; this is a usability/scoping note rather than a security hold.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact contains conflicting OpenClaw Telegram and legacy Gmail draft instructions. The OpenClaw header appears to scope the runtime behavior to Telegram, but the inconsistency should be removed to avoid wrong-channel alerts.
[SQP-2] expected: Creating an alert draft or notification is purpose-aligned for a trend alert skill and is disclosed in the artifact, though users should confirm which channel is enabled before scheduling it.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The missing-config behavior is inconsistent between creating the config from USER.md/cerebro with Telegram confirmation and stopping to run another routine; this is a workflow ambiguity, not evidence of deception or malicious behavior.
